sentences.l1: Many people are planting trees in the community.

sentences.l2: 他们做志愿服务，一起工作。
sentences.l1: They do volunteer service and work together.
Everyone digs the soil, puts in small trees, and waters them.
Planting trees is for environmental protection.
When there are more trees, the air will get better.
Small birds and small insects will also come.

sentences.l2: 本地行动让城市更美丽。
sentences.l1: Local action makes the city more beautiful.

sentences.l2: 邻居们一起种树，也认识了新朋友。
sentences.l1: Neighbors plant trees together and also get to know new friends.
The children also come to help.

sentences.l2: 我们爱地球，所以我们要保护它。
sentences.l1: We love the earth, so we want to protect it.

sentences.l2: 小树慢慢长大，我们会很开心。
sentences.l1: The small trees slowly grow up, and we will be very happy.
